document:0:393:0.text:
Step 1: Evenly apply <style="highlight">coldfire oil</style> to the surface of the damaged weapon.
Step 2: Grind the <style="highlight">firevein ore</style> into a fine powder, then sprinkle it generously over the damaged area.
Step 3: Fully immerse your <style="highlight">sword</style> in the <style="highlight">corrosive solution</style>. Heat it until it begins to boil.
Step 4: Use a standard alchemical magic circle to trigger the magical reaction.
document:0:393:0.source_cn:
第一步，将受损武器表面均匀涂抹<style="highlight">冷火油</style>。
第二步，研磨<style="highlight">金色火纹铁矿</style>直至其成为粉末，将粉末撒在武器受损部位，粉末用量必须足够修复损伤部位。
第三步，将你的<style="highlight">佩剑</style>完全浸入<style="highlight">酸蚀液</style>，并加热至微微沸腾。
第四步，使用经典炼金魔法阵，进行魔法反应。
